documents.title: ADR 0161: BROC persistent practice for existing Stars
ADR 0162: Local durable ingress queue for the Premium relay

decision.target: Existing local Premium Docker runtime only; no public application cutover
decision.acceptance_basis: The owner explicitly directed use of BROCCOLIQUEUE and BroccoliDB for a local queue in front of the existing relay runtime.

documents.title: ADR 0163: Star candidate selection before exhibition

decision.target: GALX source and disposable PostgreSQL verification; no shared database migration or application deployment
decision.acceptance_basis: The institutional mandate requires an explicit selection decision before new Star work is exhibited.

documents.title: ADR 0164: Independent Star patronage and private creation

decision.target: Local application and migration; live legacy catalog archived, replacement catalog inactive; no paid launch

documents.title: ADR 0165: GALX Media, Connect and Nova boundaries

decision.target: Local source and isolated fixtures; disabled by default; no production migration or deployment
decision.acceptance_basis: The user explicitly directed the Media/Connect/Nova responsibility split and bounded implementation. Explicit operator entitlement is a documented implementation assumption, not a new price or subscription migration.

documents.title: ADR 0166: Canonical origin at the private self-host listener

decision.target: Private Mac listener and synthetic whole-image acceptance; public activation excluded
decision.revision: New candidate in dated correction record
decision.acceptance_basis: User explicitly authorized the narrow self-host origin/transport source correction and a superseding candidate; no authorization to enable production traffic.

documents.title: ADR 0167: Mac Nova runtime and Vercel inference retirement

decision.target: Controlled Mac Nova ingress at nova.galx.ai; existing GALX Media and Connect retained on Vercel; no public launch
decision.acceptance_basis: Owner explicitly authorized the gated real-provider transition, Nova-only cutover and Vercel retirement. No broader commercial/public activation.

documents.title: ADR 0168: Local PostgreSQL for GALXAI and Premium

decision.acceptance_basis: Owner explicitly requested on-device PostgreSQL and continued migration for GALXAI and Premium. Partial local delivery: Premium execution database cut over after source fencing/final verification; central Auth/web privately accepted but not public. Hosted retirement and complete central cutover remain pending.
